RESEARCH

# I study psychological processes within environmental, social, educational, and performance contexts.

::: {.research-lead}
My research programme focuses on understanding how individual psychological processes interact with the contexts in which they occur.
:::

::: {.research-intro}
My work spans climate change and mental health, pro-environmental behaviour, psychological counselling and education, digital behaviour, emotion regulation, and sport psychology. Rather than treating these as isolated topics, I approach them as interconnected components of a broader programme examining how psychological processes are shaped across different life contexts.
:::

:::
:::

::: {.research-section}
::: {.research-shell}

::: {.section-kicker}
RESEARCH PROGRAMME
:::

## Four interconnected lines of research

::: {.research-program-grid}

::: {.research-program-card}
::: {.research-number}
01
:::

### Climate & Environmental Psychology

This line of research examines the psychological consequences of climate change, climate anxiety, mental-health responses to environmental threats, and psychological determinants of pro-environmental behaviour.

**Key themes**

- Climate anxiety and climate emotions
- Climate change and mental health
- Pro-environmental behaviour
- Psychological mechanisms
- Social norms and environmental behaviour
:::

::: {.research-program-card}
::: {.research-number}
02
:::

### Psychological Counselling, Education & Psychosocial Contexts

This line focuses on how counselling and educational processes intersect with contextual conditions such as poverty, trauma, and social disadvantage.

**Key themes**

- Poverty-sensitive school counselling
- Trauma-informed education
- School-based psychosocial support
- Teacher professional development
- Inclusive education and school contexts
:::

::: {.research-program-card}
::: {.research-number}
03
:::

### Digital Behaviour & Emotion Regulation

I examine psychological and interpersonal processes associated with behaviour in digital environments, alongside adaptive and maladaptive patterns of emotion regulation.

**Key themes**

- Cyberbullying and cybervictimisation
- Digital citizenship
- Empathy and resilience
- Cognitive emotion regulation
- Adaptive and maladaptive psychological processes
:::

::: {.research-program-card}
::: {.research-number}
04
:::

### Sport & Performance Psychology

This research line focuses on psychological functioning in athletes, psychological performance, and intervention-based approaches. I aim to connect academic research with the realities of performance environments.

**Key themes**

- Athlete psychology
- Psychological performance
- Mindfulness-based interventions
- Psychological functioning and distress
- Psychological processes in football
:::

METHODOLOGICAL APPROACH
:::

## Selecting methods to fit the research question

::: {.research-method-grid}

::: {.research-method-item}
### Quantitative Research

Multivariable models, mediation and moderation analyses, psychometric evaluation, and multilevel approaches.
:::

::: {.research-method-item}
### Qualitative Research

Case study and qualitative approaches for understanding contextual and experiential processes.
:::

::: {.research-method-item}
### Evidence Synthesis

Systematic review, meta-analysis, and evidence-mapping approaches for integrating fragmented findings.
:::

::: {.research-method-item}
### Reproducible Research

R-based analytical workflows, open-science practices, and transparent reporting of analytical decisions whenever possible.
:::
